name: semantic-linter
description: Detects semantic trap words in LLM instruction files and helps narrow wide-boundary wording.

interface.longDescription: Use Semantic-Linter to check Skill, prompt, agent, and project instruction files for wide-boundary wording, consult the bundled semantic trap lexicon, and generate a lightweight rules pointer for project-level guidance.
defaultPrompt: Check this instruction file for semantic trap wording.
Help me maintain the semantic trap lexicon.
